entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 2817, Standbuch 1011, Folio: 220r, Schreiber: Lorenz Fries
entries.german: Nach ir beder dotlicher abgang, kame solche vertzinsung vf egedachten Wilhelmen Zobels dochter Georgen von Rosenbergs hausfrawen, dieselben bede eheleute, verkaufften hernach die 100 fl bete zu Farhe, dem Probste, Dechant vnd Capitel des stiffts haug fur 1000 fl, vnd liessen die itzgedachten heren zu Haug den Inwoneren zu Farhe an der jarlichen bete 40 fl nach, vnd namen mit mer des jars dan 60 fl, zogen aber solche bete fur aigen ein, vnd wolten dem stifft Wirtzburg kainer widerlosung daruf gestaten, dargegen sagt (durchgestrichen: allegiert) B. Rudolf das angeregte alienation der bete zu Farh on wissen vnd wollen des Domcapitels beschehn, vnd deshalben on crafft vnd wirkung were, (durchgestrichen: darumb er begerte) und begert darumb, das der stifft haug ime die gemelten bete zu Farh on entgelt gutlich wieder volgen lassen wollte, dan wa das nit beschehe, muste er si derwegen mit recht beclagen, vnd ob ime ainiger chosten daruf lauffen, des gedechte er sich an inen auch zuerholen, aber die heren des Stiffts Haug wollten sich mit ime als irem Landsfursten nit einlassen sunder baten darfur, vnd wurde die sache durch vnterhandlung vertragen dermaßen, das die inwonere zu Farhe (bis die gantz bete wider an den stifft gelost wurde) jherlich 80 fl zu bete geben, davon der halbtail bischofe Rudolfen vnd (durchgestrichen: dem) seinem stiffte, vnd der ander halbtail den Capitel zu Haug ertrichten werden solte, doch mit dem gedinge, wan er b. Rudolf oder seine nachkomen dem gedachten Capitel 700 hinausgeben wurden, das alsdan die gantzen bete, nemlich 100fl. Dem Stiffte hinfur allain volkomenlich, wie vor alter herkomen, entricht werden, und die heren von hauf an berurter bete ferner gar nichts mer haben sollten, das also von bedentailen angenomen vnd bewilligt, vnd haben die Hauger hern ime b. Rudolfen des iren besigelten Revers vbergeben. Actum am Sambstag Exaltationis Crucis anno 1471. iuxta in primo Rudolfi fo. 231. Vnd (löst) hat gedachter B. Rudolf volgener Zeit soliche bete wider an stiffte (gelost).
entries.english: After both their deaths, that rent passed to the aforementioned daughter of Wilhelm Zobel, Georg von Rosenberg’s wife. The couple later sold the annual rent of 100 florins at Fahr to the provost, dean, and chapter of the foundation at Haug for 1,000 florins. They left the people of Fahr with 40 florins of the annual rent and took more than 60 florins each year, treating the rent as their own property and refusing to allow the bishopric of Würzburg to redeem it. Rudolf, Bischof, argued that the rent’s alienation had taken place without the cathedral chapter’s knowledge or consent and was therefore invalid, and asked the foundation at Haug to restore it without payment; otherwise he would sue them and seek recovery of any costs. The canons of Haug declined to engage with him as their territorial lord and petitioned against the claim. The matter was settled: until the entire rent was redeemed for the bishopric, the people of Fahr would pay 80 florins each year, half to Rudolf, Bischof, and his foundation and half to the chapter at Haug. If Rudolf, Bischof, or his successors paid the chapter 700 florins, the entire rent of 100 florins would thereafter be paid solely to the bishopric, as it had been formerly, and the canons of Haug would have no further claim. Both sides accepted this and the canons gave Rudolf, Bischof, a sealed reverse. Done on Saturday, the Feast of the Exaltation of the Cross, 1471. According to Rudolf’s first register, fol. 231. Rudolf, Bischof, later redeemed the rent for the bishopric.

facts.content: sold, together with his wife, the annual rent of 100 florins at Fahr to the provost, dean, and chapter of Haug for 1,000 florins.

was party to a settlement with Bishop Rudolf over the rent at Fahr he and his wife had sold; until redemption, the residents were to pay an annual rent split between the bishopric and the chapter of Haug.
